visual_unit_contract.editability: Keep all non-source-crop text, table cells, formula labels, diagram labels, and callouts editable.
visual_unit_contract.equation_and_diagram_provenance: Set data-visual-unit and data-evidence-ref on equations and mechanism diagrams.

source_reuse_contract.local_interpretation: Every placement needs a placement-specific figcaption or evidence-readout; reuse must explain a different panel, comparison, mechanism, or implication.

source_id_contract.rule: Use exact ingest source ids in layout slots and evidence blocks; never invent replacement ids for paper visuals.

slot_contract.order: Reserve figure/table bounding-box slots before writing final body copy.
slot_contract.caption_zone: Each source-backed slide keeps a caption or evidence-readout zone in the same or adjacent panel.
slot_contract.wide_table: Subset a table wider than 8 columns to a narrative 4-6 column native table.

editable_callouts: When copy names a row, cell, panel, curve, or result, anchor an editable callout to the relevant figure or table block.
speaker_notes: For speaker-ready decks, explain the claim, evidence, transition, and why the visual matters in plain spoken language.
claim_coverage: When a claim graph exists, slide.covers must retain relevant tension, mechanism, evidence, and implication nodes.
repair_order: remove unverifiable numbers or bind them to evidence_quote
reduce copy or split a slide before shrinking evidence
revise storyboard and grouped slots before individual bounding boxes
